# B-Rod or Custom (concept by Kerblabs)

> Concept site for B-Rod or Custom, a Corvette restoration shop in Knoxville, TN. Facts from b-rodorcustom.com. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the business.

## Facts
- Owner: Larry Burchett
- Focus: 1963 to 1967 Corvettes, nearly 40 years
- GM licensed C2 body dealer
- SEMA member since 2004
- Contact: contact form on b-rodorcustom.com (no email published)
